_comment: Hand-curated, deliberately manual (like votes.json) — the scraper never writes this file.
Keyed by candidate id from candidates.json. Powers the Summary of Challengers section.
- Factual only: job title / occupation and past runs for elected office.
- NO party affiliation of any kind, for any candidate, at any level of government.
Municipal races in Ontario are non-partisan and the dashboard stays that way.
- No characterizations, endorsements, controversies, or qualitative reads — those
belong in research/ (git-ignored) per the Public-Repo Policy, if anywhere.
- Where no biography could be verified from a public source, leave the fields empty.
An empty bio is honest; an invented one is the failure this project guards against.
- registration_date is NOT stored here — it comes from candidates.json (clerk-published
only). Markham and Whitchurch-Stouffville publish no filing dates, so those stay blank.

aurora-mayor-john-gallo.occupation: Aurora Ward 5 Councillor; manages a local business
aurora-mayor-john-gallo.past_runs: Has served roughly 14 years on Aurora Town Council

aurora-mayor-shawn-deane.notes: Regular delegate to Aurora Council on budget and financial matters
